story:
Tropical South Tree Services was founded in Cutler Bay in March 2019 by Rafael Quezada. What began as a commitment to honest, reliable tree care has grown into one of Miami-Dade County's most trusted tree service operations — built on word of mouth, real results, and a 5.0-star rating across more than 200 Google reviews.

**When you call, you talk to the owner.** Rafael personally responds to every enquiry and quotes every job, usually the same day. There is no call centre in between, and no salesman on commission deciding what your tree needs. When the crew turns up, they are the same people Rafael trained and works alongside — and the quote you were given is the price you pay.

**Licensed and insured, and we will show you.** Tropical South carries Commercial General Liability insurance on every job, and we provide documentation before work begins as a matter of course rather than on request. That matters most when the work is happening thirty feet up, directly over your roof, your pool cage or a neighbour's property.

**We handle the paperwork the county requires.** Miami-Dade requires permits to remove protected and heritage species, and Coral Gables and Pinecrest administer their own permitting on top of the county's. Getting this wrong carries substantial fines and mandatory replacement planting. We identify what is protected during the quote, tell you plainly what applies to your property, and coordinate the application. Where a written assessment is needed — for a permit, an insurance claim, an HOA dispute or a property matter — we work directly with ISA certified arborists to provide it. That independence is deliberate: a report is only worth having if the person who wrote it does not profit from its conclusion.

**Full cleanup is part of the job.** We bring our own chipper and chip truck to every job rather than hiring when a storm is forecast, which is the difference between debris leaving with us the same day and a pile at your kerb waiting weeks on county pickup. Driveways, walkways and pool decks are blown clean before we pack up. It is included, not an add-on.

**And we answer at 2am.** Storm damage does not keep business hours. We run 24/7 emergency response across Miami-Dade — from Homestead and Redland up through Kendall, Pinecrest, Coral Gables and the City of Miami — and Rafael takes those calls himself.

If you need a tree looked at, call **(305) 299-1189**. We will give you an honest answer about what it needs, including when the answer is that it does not need anything at all.
